item.title: Project Officer, Moldova & Armenia
item.description: Context International IDEA has a mandate to support democracy worldwide. Since its establishment in 1995, the Institute has sought to fulfil this mandate by incrementally expanding its geographic footprint. Increasing demand for the Institute´s support in countries in Europe, coupled with key developments that have highlighted the weakness of democratic institutions in some European countries, has motivated the Institute to establish a Regional Europe Programme (REP). Through its Regional Europe Programme, the Institute provides knowledge and technical support to reform processes aimed at protecting the integrity of elections, democratic and inclusive constitution-making processes, parliamentary strengthening and combating political corruption. The Institute integrates gender, diversity and conflict sensitivity aspects across all its programmes. International IDEA is implementing the regional project Strengthening Institutional and Civic Responses to Digital Threats in Moldova and Armenia. The project strengthens the expertise and cooperation of state institutions, civil society organisations, watchdog groups and independent media to identify, assess and respond to information manipulation and foreign interference affecting elections and democratic governance. Through needs assessments, peer learning, policy dialogue, practical training and regional exchange, it aims to reinforce information integrity, accountability and public confidence. The Project Officer will support the implementation of International IDEA's regional project across Moldova and Armenia, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery of activities. Under the supervision of the Project Manager, s/he will contribute to planning, coordination, monitoring and reporting, stakeholder engagement and knowledge sharing. Duties and Responsibilities Contributes to the implementation and coordination of all project activities according to the project documents, plans and agreed roadmaps in Moldova and Armenia; Drafts substantive concept notes and supports the development of budgets for implementation of project activities; Supports all aspects of event organization, including substantive, administrative and logistical elements; Delivers thematic interventions at conferences and meetings as required. Undertakes other representational functions as delegated by the line manager; Develops and maintains networks with key partners and stakeholders to ensure their engagement in project activities; Facilitates and supports the engagement of consultants in the project, develops contractual documentation, and tracks the quality of deliverables, in line with International IDEA’s policies and procedures; Monitors and provides regular updates on political and socio-economic developments in Armenia and those globally affecting Armenia and the region, to inform ongoing programme design and future potential programmatic interventions; Collaborates closely with relevant International IDEA colleagues in Brussels and Stockholm, HQ for the successful implementation of the project activities, provides guidance to other junior colleagues; Liaises with respective multilateral and bilateral democracy assistance actors active in Armenia, to coordinate the ongoing initiatives, ensure International IDEA’s visibility and identify areas of further support; Supports the Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) component of the project, ensuring adherence with International IDEA’s M&E results framework; Supports the monitoring of the project’s budget and contributes to grant management; Drafts monitoring and implementation reports for quarterly, annual and other reports. General Profile Combines a good knowledge of the state of democracy and governance in Moldova and the broader region, acquired through academic studies in political science, law, social science or related fields, and the relevant work experience; Will contribute significantly to assigned projects all along the project life cycle, i.e. from project design and funding to project assessment; will lead meetings and discussions, supervise publications and review input from external providers; Has contributed to publications on the relevant subject; is recognized as a knowledge resource in their broad professional community; Can work with minimal guidance and supervision; Adds value to team-based activities in their unit; collaborates with other entities of the Institute; Acts as a model or mentor for less experienced colleagues; Can be expected to travel globally to any geographical area involved in their projects; Follows internal procedures to ensure high standards of performance and compliance with Institutional guidelines; Acts in accordance with International IDEA’ s core values; Respect, Integrity and Professionalism; Integrates gender equality, diversity, and social inclusion (GEDSI) considerations into all tasks and activities, in alignment with the Institute’s Core Values and commitment to the GEDSI policy. Reporting line Programme Manager, Eastern Europe Education and Experience University degree in political science, law, international relations, public administration or other related discipline; Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in democracy and governance in Moldova an/or Armenia in the field of elections, political participation and representation, anti-corruption, rule of law and constitutionalism; Demonstrated experience in results-based report writing; Demonstrated experience in the implementation of projects in the field of democratic governance; Experience in resource mobilization, including conceptualization and formulation of successful funding proposals and knowledge of fundraising methods. Experience with EU-funded projects and requirements, as well as familiarity with their processes and systems is preferred. Fluency in written and spoken Romanian is required; Advanced spoken and written English is required. Fluency in the Russian language will be considered an advantage. Terms of Contract: Local Post. Fixed term appointment until 31 August 2027. Remuneration - MDL 65 299 GROSS per month Please note as this is a local post, International IDEA will bear no costs relating to the relocation of the selected candidate to the duty station. This position is open to those legally authorized to live and work in Moldova for the duration of the contract. International IDEA is not able to support work permit applications. Use of AI in Recruitment International IDEA places strong emphasis on human input in recruitment. Candidates must disclose any use of AI tools. All application materials, written assessments, and interview responses (as applicable) must be entirely human-generated and reflect the candidate’s own knowledge, skills, and experience. The use of AI to generate content or misrepresent qualifications is not permitted. AI‑powered assistive technologies (such as screen readers or speech‑to‑text tools) may be used for accessibility purposes to ensure equal access to the recruitment process. Applying for this position: Applications should be submitted online no later than 23:59 (CEST) 06 September 2026 Please note that all applications must be made in English. Selection Process: Evaluation of qualified candidates will include a written test assessment and up to two (2) interviews. Candidates selected to proceed to the next stage of the process will be contacted once all applications have been carefully reviewed. All candidates will be notified of the status of their application via email once the process has been finalized. Due to the anticipated volume of applications, International IDEA will review applications on a rolling basis, and the vacancy may close earlier than the advertised deadline. Applicants are therefore encouraged to apply early. International IDEA is an equal-opportunity employer which seeks to further diversify its staff in terms of gender, culture and nationality.

item.title: Project Officer – Electoral Risk & Cybersecurity Resilience, Moldova
item.description: Context International IDEA has a mandate to support democracy worldwide. Since its establishment in 1995, the Institute has sought to fulfil this mandate by incrementally expanding its geographic footprint. Increasing demand for the Institute´s support in countries in Europe, coupled with key developments that have highlighted the weakness of democratic institutions in some European countries, has motivated the Institute to establish a Regional Europe Programme (REP) , with a strategic focus on Eastern Europe and the Western Balkans. In Moldova, International IDEA works to enhance the resilience and quality of democratic institutions and processes, with core areas of engagement including electoral processes and political finance, parliamentary strengthening, and strengthening the capacity of civil society organizations to meaningfully participate in decision-making. The Project Officer contributes to the delivery of International IDEA's mandate in Moldova, with a particular focus on the implementation of the Shielding Democracy in Moldova project. This role will focus on the implementation and coordination of project’s component on electoral risk management, protection of elections, and cybersecurity for democratic processes, working closely with national institutions and international partners to strengthen electoral resilience against both traditional and emerging threats . The officer will be part of the expanding team working across Moldova and Brussels. Duties and Responsibilities Under the supervision of the Project Manager, implements and coordinates International IDEA´s ongoing initiatives in the field of electoral support in Moldova, and particularly its work on protecting elections, electoral risk management and cybersecurity of democratic processes in Moldova. Supports the implementation of activities aimed at strengthening institutional resilience against cyber threats, foreign information manipulation and interference (FIMI), and other technology-enabled risks affecting electoral integrity; Coordinates cooperation with national counterparts, including the Central Electoral Commission, Cybersecurity Agency, StratCom, Ministry of Defense, Anticorruption agencies and other relevant public institutions and international partners, to enhance inter-institutional cooperation on democratic and electoral resilience; Supports the development and implementation of methodologies, analytical products and technical tools related to electoral risk management and cybersecurity; Prepares concept notes and supports the development of project proposals and budgets for implementation of project activities, related to electoral resilience, cybersecurity and democratic governance; Builds and maintains networks with key stakeholders; ensures their engagement and participation in project implementation; Facilitates the recruitment and oversight of consultants, prepares contractual documentation, and ensures quality control of deliverables in line with IDEA’s policies and procedures; Coordinates the substantive and logistical aspects of project-related events, workshops, simulations, trainings and study visits; Monitors political, electoral, technological and cybersecurity developments relevant to democratic governance and provides regular analytical updates to inform programme implementation; Liaises with multilateral and bilateral partners working on elections, cybersecurity and democratic resilience in Moldova to ensure coordination, visibility and identify opportunities for collaboration and resource mobilization; Supports project implementation, budget monitoring and donor reporting; including narrative, financial and results-based reporting. General Profile Solid knowledge of democracy and governance in Moldova and the broader region, supported by an academic background in political science, law, social science or related fields, and the relevant work experience; Demonstrates the ability to work across governance, electoral and cybersecurity communities, translating technical issues into programmatic and policy responses; Able to contribute meaningfully across all phases of the project cycle, from design and funding to project assessment and evaluation; Experienced in drafting and contributing to policy documents and publications; Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team; Serves as a resource person and provides guidance to junior colleagues; Willingness and ability to travel within the region or globally, as required; Follows internal procedures to ensure high standards of performance and compliance with Institutional guidelines; Integrates gender equality, diversity, and social inclusion (GEDSI) considerations into all tasks and activities, in alignment with the Institute’s Core Values and commitment to the GEDSI policy. Reporting line Project Manager, Moldova. Education and Experience University degree in political science, law, international relations, public administration, cybersecurity, information security or another relevant discipline; Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in democracy and governance, electoral assistance, political participation and representation, anti-corruption, rule of law, cybersecurity governance, digital resilience or closely related fields; Experience working with electoral management bodies, cybersecurity authorities, government institutions or international organizations is highly desirable; Demonstrated experience in project implementation, stakeholder coordination, monitoring and results-based reporting; Experience in proposal development, donor engagement and resource mobilization is considered a strong asset; Fluency in written and spoken Romanian and English is required. Advanced proficiency in Russian is desirable. Terms of Contract: This post is advertised subject to the confirmation of funding. Local Post. Fixed term appointment until 31 March 2027 Remuneration - MDL 65 299 per month. item.title: Project Manager (Criminal Justice Reform Component - C1) RoLAC II, Nigeria
item.description: Context International Institute for Democracy and Electoral Assistance (IDEA) is an intergovernmental organization with 35 member states hailing from different continents around the world. International IDEA aims to support sustainable democracy worldwide, doing so, inter alia, by working with both new and long-established democracies to strengthen the institutions and culture of democracy. Located at the interface of research and practice, International IDEA serves as a forum for dialogue and uses comparative experience and analysis to identify good practices for democracy-building. It also produces knowledge tools and practical guides for democracy support. The Institute maintains a global network of experts, provides training materials, and offers strategic advice to democracy actors at the international, regional, and national levels. The Institute is headquartered in Stockholm with field offices in Africa and West Asia, Asia and the Pacific, and Latin America and the Caribbean. International IDEA is managing the second phase of the “Rule of Law and Anti-Corruption (RoLAC) Phase II Programme” in Nigeria. The programme is funded by the European Union (EU) for a period of five years (from 2023). The programme is working towards three anticipated Outcomes: Outcome 1: Enhanced performance, quality, and oversight of the criminal justice system and of justice service delivery. Outcome 2: Improved access to justice for vulnerable women, children, juveniles, persons with disabilities and victims of sexual and gender-based violence. Outcome 3: Increased transparency and accountability of anti-corruption systems and reforms. The Project Manager, Criminal Justice Reform Component (C1) is responsible for managing and coordinating the successful implementation of all Criminal Justice project activities under C1 of the RoLAC II Programme at both federal and state levels to achieve the following expected outcome: Enhanced performance, quality, and oversight of the criminal justice system and of justice service delivery . Duties and Responsibilities 1. Contributes to the overall development of RoLAC II programme strategies, workplans, monitoring and evaluation; Contributes to enhancing knowledge and performance of the programme; 2. Leads, manages and provides strategic direction to C1 (Criminal Justice) project activities; Manages and directs the team to deliver efficiently, within agreed timeframes and budget, and in accordance with approved procedures and processes; 3. Establishes and nurtures a working environment that is conducive to delivering results, fostering a spirit of collaboration, strong work ethic and project team cohesion; 4. Oversees the component’s planning and implementation; Closely monitors performance and prepares and provides periodic project reviews in a timely and effective manner; 5. Ensures the delivery of agreed outputs and outcomes are in cooperation and coordination with other areas of work within the RoLAC II programme, with other international IDEA programmes in Nigeria, and with external partners; 6. Develops and manages relationships with relevant stakeholders; 7. Contributes to the design and implementation of RoLAC II Monitoring and Evaluation framework in accordance with the Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) plan outlined in the Programme Design document, responding to both EU needs and aligned with International IDEA’s M&E results framework; 8. Communicates, represents and ensures the visibility of C1 is in line with RoLAC II Communication and Visibility Plan; 9. Ensures coordination and effective communication with relevant project partners, and EU Delegation to Nigeria as delegated by the Head of Nigeria Programmes; 10. Represents the C1 project externally as appropriate, including development and maintenance of positive and effective relations with the Government of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, and other relevant donors and interlocutors; 11. Initiates, leads and supports the design and implementation of measures that will engender and strengthen ownership of the RoLAC II programme interventions and outcomes by the programme’s boundary partners, with particular regard to programme initiatives and reforms under Component 1, and, where relevant, ensure a smooth transition of ownership and leadership of reform initiatives and outcomes from the programme to the boundary partner; 12. Initiates, leads, supports and oversees the design and implementation of measures to establish, improve and strengthen long-term sustainability measures for Component 1 initiatives and outcomes, and develops, monitors and evaluates metrics for tracking the Component’s sustainability objectives; 13. Ensures adherence to both EU and International IDEA regulations and procedures in project implementation and reporting; 14. Carries out other duties and responsibilities as related to the post that may be assigned from time to time. General Profile Combines in-depth knowledge, acquired through post-graduate academic achievements or hands-on experience, excellent skills including managerial skills and relevant experience in the field of Criminal Justice and Rule of Law; Leads assigned teams (including staff members and consultants) throughout the project life cycle; leads meetings and discussions; Regarded as an expert in their broad professional community; Has the intellectual leadership to integrate innovation into their field of expertise; Fosters team-based activities in their unit; collaborates with other entities of the Institute; Acts as a model and mentor for C1 colleagues; Is expected to travel globally to any geographical area involved in their project; Follows internal procedures to ensure high standards of performance and compliance with Institutional guidelines; Acts in accordance with International IDEA’s Core Values; Respect, Integrity, and Professionalism; Integrates gender equality, diversity, and social inclusion (GEDSI) considerations into all tasks and activities, in alignment with the Institute’s Core Values and commitment to the GEDSI policy. Reporting line Senior Programme Manager, RoLAC II Education and Experience Master's degree or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Criminal Justice, Law, International Development, Social Sciences, Political Science, or another related discipline; A minimum of ten (10) years of relevant experience in Criminal Justice reform and Rule of Law, project management and implementation, and the provision of expert advice; Experience working in the field of democracy and governance in Africa and other developing country contexts is essential; A minimum of five (5) years’ management experience, including senior level positions, with direct supervision over complex substantive teams; Experience with motivating and leading teams and solving issues; Demonstrated experience in programme management, including the application of monitoring and evaluation approaches, methodologies, and procedures; Experience in planning, developing and managing EU funded programmes, as well as familiarity with EU processes and systems considered an advantage; Relevant experience from an international and/or regional organization in the work of democracy assistance would be considered an asset; Excellent knowledge in written and oral English is required; Any other widely spoken language in an International IDEA priority region (Arabic, French, Spanish) and/or official EU language would be an asset Terms of Contract: Local Post.
